fields.description: When on, the public Test / Dissemination form at /anticipatory-action-test is live and a Testing Environment button + Test Data widget appear in the admin console. Test submissions never count towards real metrics or the dashboard.
fields.label: Testing / dissemination mode enabled

fields.description: Name this round of testing, e.g. "Garissa testing 2026". Every entry submitted through the test form while testing is on is tagged with this batch.
fields.label: Test batch name
Note shown on the test form

fields.description: Leave BLANK (recommended) to send AA emails through the site's default outgoing Email Account - the AA branding is in the email body, not a separate From address. Optionally pick a specific outgoing account here to route AA mail through it instead (the From then reads "Anticipatory Action <that account's address>"). Either way AA email - welcome, set-password, sign-up, approvals, pillar enquiries - sends as long as the chosen/default account can send.
fields.label: Send AA emails via
